bluf: Russia struck Ukraine's energy infrastructure with ballistic missiles and drones while Kyiv again received no early warning from allied partners, though the US denied pausing intelligence sharing. The UN World Food Programme is cutting aid to 500,000 Palestinians in Gaza due to funding shortages, reducing monthly assistance to 1.1 million from 1.6 million people. A Houthi attack on a Yemeni government military camp killed over 30 and wounded 70 using three ballistic missiles amid escalating conflict, while Iran reiterated its offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days. France is experiencing widespread rioting with 2,400 arrests across multiple cities as masked groups attack public buildings and loot shops, with tensions reflecting frustration over living costs and inequality that observers warn may benefit the far-right. Ukraine conducted drone strikes on Russian Yandex data centers, disrupting civilian services for millions of Russians, reportedly prompting responses that have soured relations between Trump and Zelenskyy.
